configuration.native_build: cargo build --release --features mimalloc --workspace via Maven bench profile
configuration.input: runtime RowData source fromSequence mapped to nullable INT id
configuration.query: INSERT INTO sink SELECT id, tick(id), tick(id + 1) FROM src
configuration.udfs: one shared non-deterministic IntTick, LongTick or TextTick per query
configuration.clock: complete executeSql(...).await(); environment creation and explain-plan checks outside timer
configuration.native_route_assertions: NativeCalc plus both transposes, no fallback, exact consumed rows, exact per-job directPrimitiveCalcRows delta in retained runs

optimization_budget.authorized: about one hour if profiling found no clear opportunities
optimization_budget.approach: two focused prototypes; retain generated row loop only for numeric/boolean inputs and outputs; preserve original string row dispatch; remove embedded-body prototype

limitations: Complete jobs retain both perimeter conversions, production ownership, JNI where intrinsic and rowwise sink copying. No isolated Rust-kernel or small-functionality speedup is claimed.
Warmup and measurement trials are retained. Different JVM cohorts and paired stock controls drift; medians and overlapping ranges do not establish a universal speedup.

Profile timings are diagnostic and excluded from performance claims. Profile counts are sampled CPU observations or estimated Java allocation weights, not exact time partitions, allocation requests or copied bytes.
Inclusive profile counts overlap. UDF work can be inlined into generated evaluator frames; argument/result boxing and useful UDF execution cannot be cleanly separated from samples alone.

External compute monitoring checks Java/Rust/C compiler and javadoc processes; zero observations does not establish that the entire host is idle. Earlier diagnostic recordings overlapped external Java work.

The first all-results small-batch 2.2 baseline cohort overlapped external Java builds and contains large outliers, including a 14.145653099 s stock trial. It is retained as diagnostic evidence and is not used as the retained implementation headline.
Correctness-verified UDF execution remains default-enabled under the accepted performance exception even when complete jobs lose to stock Flink.
